The '''Tree Gnome Village''' is a village led by [[King Bolren]]. Part of the [[Gnomish Kingdoms]], it lies at the centre of a [[Gnome maze|giant hedge maze]]. To enter the village, navigate the gnome maze and then squeeze through the loose railing. Once you've reached the centre and started the [[Tree Gnome Village]] quest, [[Elkoy]] will offer you quick travel between the maze entrance and the village.

==Transportation==
*[[Spirit Tree]] teleport directly to the centre of the maze.
*[[Fairy ring]] to ({{Fairycode|ciq}}) and run west and then north.
*[[Ardougne cloak]] teleport to [[Ardougne Monastery]] and run west.
*Inside the city is a [[Portal (Player-owned house)|house portal]], which can be reached with a [[Teleport to House|House Teleport]] spell or tablet if your [[player-owned house]] is located in Yanille.
*A [[Yanille tablet]] (made from using a [[scroll of redirection]] on a house tablet) can be used to teleport to the Yanille house portal, even if your house is located elsewhere.
*[[Minigame teleport]] to [[fishing trawler|Fishing Trawler]] and run west.
*[[Ardougne Teleport]] [[Ardougne teleport|(tablet)]], run south.
*[[Ring of dueling]], from [[Castle Wars]]--this is a longer walk but has no skill or quest requirements.

==Notable features==
*[[Tree Gnome Village dungeon]] - There are [[skeleton]]s, [[giant bat]]s, and [[hobgoblin]]s in here, as well as a jail with a gnome called [[Golrie]] (he is featured in the [[Waterfall Quest]] and [[Regicide]] and [[Roving Elves]] quests).
*[[Spirit Tree]] - After completing [[Tree Gnome Village]] quest, you can use this. It can teleport you to the [[Grand Exchange]], south of [[Ardougne]], and the [[Tree Gnome Stronghold]].
*[[Bolkoy's Village Shop]] - A [[general store]] ran by [[Bolkoy]].
